name: underdog-2026
label: Underdog - The Other Other
description: Look B for Underdog, 26 September - 3 October 2026. A dark warm ground with hot gold accent and a struck-through red for emphasis. Anton supplies the blunt modern condensed headlines; IM Fell English carries the period body. Restrained overlay on the Criterion house theme: it retunes ground, accents, texture, watermark and type only. Grid, type scale, lockup geometry, QR card, CTA and next-strip placement stay engine-owned.

_colour_notes.ground: Warm soot black. Ratio against text is 14.63:1.
_colour_notes.accent: Hot gold for headlines, CTAs and emphasis marks. Ratio against ground is 8.62:1; safe as text.
_colour_notes.secondary: Struck-through red for rules, separators and small emphasis only. Ratio against ground is 3.37:1 - RULE COLOUR ONLY, never running copy.
_colour_notes.text: Warm parchment. Ratio against ground is 14.63:1; the body-text floor is 10:1.
_colour_notes.muted_text: Aged paper for footlines and small print. Ratio against ground is 8.02:1; above the 7:1 muted floor.

_font_notes: Anton and IM Fell English are both in APPROVED_FONTS in platform/obs-helper/js/theme-loader.js and the corresponding .woff2 files are present in platform/obs-helper/assets/fonts/. The theatre dry-run still has to prove the fonts serve HTTP 200 with no LOADING hang; that is a deployment check, not a schema one.
_watermark_notes: No show-specific watermark drawn yet. The engine falls back to the house Criterion roofline mark, which is acceptable for the prototype and keeps the foyer recognisably Criterion-hosted.
_texture_notes: No texture drawn yet. The ground renders flat, which is consistent with the clean modern/period contrast of look B.
_poster_frame_notes: Parchment-style mat suits the period body type and the warm dark ground.
_phase_intensity_notes: Preshow bright and welcoming; interval slightly dimmed for the break; postshow dimmed for a long loop in a thinning bar.
_motion_notes: Cover photographs move gently within crop margin; contained photographs zoom from 94% to 100% inside the box. Posters, QR codes and text remain still. Seeded gold motes appear only on cards with explicit sales_intent. Both effects are suppressed by Reduced mode and can be disabled per show.
